description: This script creates a binary header for a file by packing entry address, load address, and size into a structured binary format, then prepends this header to the input file to produce an output file.
external_files: The script reads from an input file and writes to an output file specified via command line arguments.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, auto-detecting the numeral system based on prefix (e.g., 0x for hex).

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header by packing entry address, load address, and size into a big-endian unsigned integer struct.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads the input file, creates a header, and writes the header along with the file content to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command line arguments, sets default addresses if not provided, and initiates output creation.
